info.title: Intake Sources
info.description: The places records arrive from: a watched folder, a mailbox, an inbound endpoint. Ours used to be one mailbox in a settings screen, which made a second mailbox a code change. As objects they can be listed, switched off, permissioned and audited like everything else (ADR-031). Materialised by the SeedIntakeSourceRegister repair step; OpenRegister does not self-import its own register JSON at boot (ADR-037).

x-openregister.description: Administered intake sources. Nothing here polls: a source names where records come from and whether it is switched on, and the app that reads it does the polling.

intake-sources.title: Intake Sources
intake-sources.description: Where records arrive from. One row per watched folder, mailbox or inbound endpoint, each switchable off without being deleted.

intake-source.title: Intake source
intake-source.summary: A place records arrive from, switchable off without being deleted.
intake-source.description: A watched folder, a mailbox or an inbound endpoint, held as an object so there can be more than one. `enabled` is the switch: a disabled source stops being polled and stays listed, so turning one off is not the same as losing what it was. `connection` names the credential or connection the poller resolves, because a secret does not belong in an object.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: The source's stable name, referenced by whatever polls it.

title.title: Title
title.description: What to call this source in a list.

description.title: Description
description.description: What arrives here, in the words of whoever set it up.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What sort of place this is. The poller for that kind reads the location and the settings.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this source is polled. A disabled source stays listed.

location.title: Location
location.description: The folder path, the mailbox address or the endpoint path, by kind.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: The connection or credential the poller resolves for this source. A secret never lives on the object.

targetRegister.title: Target register
targetRegister.description: The register arriving records are written to.

targetSchema.title: Target schema
targetSchema.description: The schema arriving records are written as.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Per-kind settings: the folder's file filter, the mailbox's folder, the endpoint's expected content type.

state.title: State
state.description: Where the source stands. Written by whatever polls it, not by hand.

lastPolledAt.title: Last polled at
lastPolledAt.description: When this source was last read. Empty means it has not been read yet, which is not the same as failing.

lastError.title: Last error
lastError.description: What went wrong the last time, so a failing source explains itself in the list.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: UUID of the organisation this source belongs to. Empty for a shared one.
